_doc: Atlas engine config. Copy to ~/.config/atlas/config.json (or point $ATLAS_CONFIG at it). Every key is optional; the values shown are the built-in defaults. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_doc_vault_root: Absolute or ~-relative path to the Obsidian vault root. Every script resolves paths under this directory; --vault CLI flags override it per run.
_doc_owner_name: Your display name, used by scripts that attribute authored notes to you. Empty means unset.
_doc_timezone: IANA timezone name for date stamps and daily-note boundaries.
_doc_folders: Bare folder names (no slashes) directly under vault_root. Rename to match your own layout; the keys are fixed.

folders._doc_daily: Daily notes, one file per day.
folders._doc_projects: PARA projects, including Clients/<client>/ and Work/<slug>/ subtrees.
folders._doc_resources: PARA reference material, including Books/. Note templates live under the meta folder (see _doc_meta).
folders._doc_archive: PARA archive of retired projects and areas.
folders._doc_meta: Machine-maintained dashboards, MOCs, research reports, and the Templates/ folder the scaffold ships.
folders._doc_attachments: Binary attachments; excluded from linting and search.
folders._doc_clippings: Web clippings saved by the Obsidian Web Clipper.
folders._doc_raw: Machine-owned source mirrors, one subfolder per connector (raw/gmail, raw/slack, ...).
